name: Marsha Blackburn

issue_poll.name: Vanderbilt Poll, Nov 18–Dec 4, 2024 (top priority, n=955 RV); ETSU Tennessee Poll, July 10–17, 2024 (biggest problems, n=701)
issue_poll.note: No pre-election TN poll with a full most-important-issue ranking found. Ranked by each issue's highest share in either poll: Vanderbilt Q2 asks top priority for state government (economy 15% + inflation 12% merged); ETSU (https://news.etsu.edu/articles/tennessee-poll-reflects-growing-concern-over-states-direction-economy-social-issues) published only top three for TN and USA ('politics' 27% dropped as untestable; 'violence and gun violence' 11% used for crime). Ranks 9–10 from Gallup national, Sept 16–28, 2024, extremely important: democracy 49%, national security 45% (https://news.gallup.com/file/poll/651749/2024_10_09_Vote%20Issues%20Topline%20and%20Tabs.pdf).
